notes.title: Development Log: 🦅 A Sacred Bond
notes.content: [h2]🦅 Development Log: A Sacred Bond[/h2][p]For centuries, [b]eagles and hawks[/b] have played an important role in hunting traditions around the world:[/p][list][*][p]In [b]Mongolia[/b], golden eagles were trained to hunt foxes and hares in the harsh steppes.[/p][/*][*][p]In [b]Turkey and Central Asia[/b], falconry became a symbol of skill and status, passed down through generations.[/p][/*][*][p]For [b]Indigenous tribes in North America[/b], birds of prey were not only hunting partners but also sacred beings, guides, and a vital source of life.[/p][/*][/list][p]These traditions were born out of the need to survive in unforgiving environments, but they also carried a [b]spiritual meaning[/b]. The bond between hunter and bird represented [b]trust, respect, and harmony with nature[/b].[/p][p]With the [b]Eagle Companion[/b], we want players to feel that same bond — not just a companion who fights by your side, but a true partner who helps you track, hunt, and survive.[/p][h3]With this special partner, you can:[/h3][list][*][p]Hunt small animals — for example, command your eagle to catch a snake and bring it back.[/p][/*][*][p]Take direct control of the eagle, using it almost like a [b]drone[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Use its [b]thermal vision[/b] to sense nearby dangers or spot wildlife.[/p][/*][/list][p]The eagle is not just a visual companion; it will be a [b]vital support in your struggle for survival[/b].[/p][previewyoutube="xNz6VtzRBH4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: The Lost Hunter - DevLog
notes.content:
[b]“Precision Guided Bullet” Mechanics[/b]
This feature is activated at the user's discretion after shooting a certain number of animals and allows free movement in a 45 degree circle using the mouse. 

[b]Additional Information[/b]
[list]
[*] This mechanic is only activated using sniper weapons in the game.
[*] Acts in synchronization with the slow-motion bullet tracking mechanic.
[*] Activated at the user's request.
[*] After use, the counter is reset and the same number of animals must be hunted to activate the feature again
[/list]

[b]You can watch the video by clicking the Youtube link. [/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kagLViEPNdE
